text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Insurance Group plans major foray in life insurance market.
- DHL's regional distribution centre in Bahrain to undergo a $2 million expansion.
- Oil and industry minister says $50 million will be allocated to develop Bahrain's oil refinery.
- Trial of two Qataris accused of spying for Qatar begins in Bahrain on Wednesday.
- Property sales in November jump 20 percent to around seven million dinars.
- Shura council supports Bahrain's decision to boycott Gulf Arab summit in Doha on December 7.
